extName.message: fenshot: chess board to FEN, one click
extName.description: Extension name in the store and the browser. At most 75 characters; keep 'fenshot' first, lowercase.

extDescription.message: Chess screenshot to FEN in one click: reads the board on any page, and whole games from move lists. Runs entirely on your device.
extDescription.description: Store short description. At most 132 characters.

actionTitle.message: Read the chessboard on this page

siteButtonLabel.description: Button added under finished games on chess.com and Lichess. Short.

siteButtonTitle.message: Open this finished game on Kibitzo's free analysis board

pillOn.description: Popup switch label when the site button is on. Short.

pillOff.description: Same switch when off; keep the leading +. Short.

pillOnTip.message: Analyze in Kibitzo appears under finished chess.com and Lichess games. Click to turn it off.

pillOffTip.message: Adds an Analyze in Kibitzo button under finished games on chess.com and Lichess. One click opens the game on a free analysis board.

position.description: Card title: the position read from the page.

game.description: Card title: a whole game read from a move list.

srcPage.message: read from the image on this tab

srcArea.message: read from the area you selected

srcImage.message: read from the image you provided

srcNothing.message: nothing read from the image on this tab

gameSource.message: read from the move list printed on this tab

gameSourceMany.message: read from the move lists printed on this tab
gameSourceMany.description: Lowercase subtitle, several games on the page.

variantGame.message: This is a Chess960 (or other variant) game. fenshot imports standard chess games only.

navStart.description: Tooltip: jump to the first move.

navEnd.description: Tooltip: jump to the last move.

selectBoard.message: Select the board on this page

readingBoardPage.message: Reading the board on this page…

runsOnDevice.description: Lowercase hint under the loading message.

noBoardPage.message: No chessboard found on this page.

noBoardImage.message: No chessboard found in that image.

somethingWrong.message: Something went wrong reading that image.

hintSelectBelow.message: if you can see one, select it below

hintTighter.message: try a tighter box around just the board

hintClearer.message: try a clearer shot, or another way below

hintUploadPaste.message: upload an image or paste one with $KEYS$
hintUploadPaste.description: Lowercase hint. $KEYS$ is the paste shortcut (Ctrl+V or ⌘V).

legalityWarning.message: This position is not fully legal as read. Open it in the editor to fix squares.

hardShort.message: Hard to read: some squares may be wrong

hardFull.message: This piece set is hard to read, some squares are probably wrong. Verify before trusting the analysis.

notLegalShort.message: Not fully legal as read: fix in the editor

wrongBoard.message: Wrong board or messy read? Select the area

dragBox.message: Drag a box around the board

tagline.description: Lowercase slogan under the name in the popup header.

toMove.description: Lowercase label before the White/Black toggle (side to move).

atBottom.description: Lowercase. Tooltip of the button that says which side is at the bottom of the board in the image; shown as "at the bottom: White". Short.

footerLocal.description: Lowercase footer, followed by a link 'open source'.

openSource.description: Lowercase footer link to the source code.

pasteHint.message: or paste a screenshot with $KEYS$ · drag & drop works too
pasteHint.description: Lowercase hint under the Upload button. $KEYS$ is the paste shortcut.
